+## #1902 - Reproducible off-screen User Guide screenshots via ShellUi + View3D
+
+- **What was decided:**
+  1. Render all 13 User Guide screenshots off-screen from the real `ShellUi` + `View3D` egui harness using `egui_kittest::Harness` (at `1200x760`, quantized to an indexed PNG palette and verified under `5_000..=650_000` bytes and `1000..=1400` px wide), driven by `cargo xtask docs-images` (and `--check` for validation).
+  2. Commit three lightweight clean-room parametric demo projects alongside `examples/first-part.camproj`: `examples/guide-workholding.camproj`, `examples/guide-3d.camproj`, and `examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj`, plus a shared CSS `.guide-pair` side-by-side layout rule in `site/static/style.css`.
+  3. Keep UI/harness generation inside `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/` (`guide_projects.rs`, `guide_images.rs`) behind explicit `#[ignore]` rendering tests invoked via `CAMCRAFT_GUIDE_IMAGES_OUT` and `CAMCRAFT_GUIDE_PROJECTS_OUT`, while enforcing manifest/PNG/Markdown invariants in non-ignored unit and `xtask` integration tests.
+
+- **Why:**
+  - Using the real `ShellUi` + `View3D` off-screen software renderer (already active in `camcraft-ui` snapshot tests without X11/Wayland) produces authentic, drift-proof screenshots that reflect real UI typography, theme tokens, toolpaths, stock/vise geometry, and collision state rather than hand-taken or external screenshots.
+  - Separating fast verification (`cargo xtask docs-images --check` and `demo_projects_build_and_load_with_valid_paths`) from image regeneration (`#[ignore]`) keeps normal `cargo test` fast while giving contributors a single repeatable regeneration command.
+  - Parameterizing `examples/guide-*.camproj` strictly from clean-room primitives and `camcraft_app::commands` guarantees zero third-party geometry or vendor trademarks.
+
+- **Considered and dropped:**
+  - Launching the native windowed binary against Xvfb/Wayland for screenshots: fragile across headless CI and contributor environments, non-deterministic across GPU drivers.
+  - Shipping raw unquantized RGBA PNGs or higher-resolution captures: bloated git diffs (> 1 MB total vs ~1.4 MB / ~60 KB–220 KB per image after quantization) without visual improvement at documentation column width.
+  - Storing synthetic SVG mockups for UI views instead of rendered screenshots: misses actual panel/viewport behavior and drifts silently when widgets change.
+
+- **Cost to change later:** Low — the manifest (`MANIFEST` and `DEMO_PROJECTS` in `xtask/src/docs_images.rs`) and scene camera/parameter recipes (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_images.rs`) are declarative tables that can be re-rendered anytime with `cargo xtask docs-images`.

+from urllib.parse import urljoin + + +ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] +SITE = ROOT / "site" +GUIDE = SITE / "content/guide" +IMAGES_DIR = SITE / "static/images/guide" +EXAMPLES_DIR = ROOT / "examples" + +REQUIRED_PAGES = [ + "set-up/setups.md", + "set-up/workholding.md", + "operations/operations-2d.md", + "operations/operations-3d.md", + "multi-axis/operations-multiaxis.md", + "multi-axis/indexed.md", +] + +REQUIRED_DEMOS = [ + "first-part.camproj", + "guide-workholding.camproj", + "guide-3d.camproj", + "guide-multiaxis.camproj", +] + +IMAGE_RE = re.compile(r"!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*images/guide/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.png))\)") +PNG_SIG = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + + +def png_dimensions(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]: + data = path.read_bytes() + if len(data) < 24 or data[:8] != PNG_SIG or data[12:16] != b"IHDR": + raise AssertionError(f"{path} is not a valid PNG with IHDR") + width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24]) + return width, height + + +class GuideImgParser(HTMLParser): + def __init__(self) -> None: + super().__init__() + self.guide_imgs: list[tuple[str, str]] = [] + + def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None: + if tag != "img": + return + mapping = dict(attrs) + src = mapping.get("src") or "" + if "images/guide/" in src: + self.guide_imgs.append((src, mapping.get("alt") or "")) + + +class GuideImagesTest(unittest.TestCase): + def test_committed_demo_projects_exist(self) -> None: + missing = [name for name in REQUIRED_DEMOS if not (EXAMPLES_DIR / name).is_file()] + self.assertEqual(missing, [], f"Missing committed demo project(s): {missing}") + + def test_required_pages_embed_optimised_rendered_pngs_with_alt_text(self) -> None: + self.assertTrue(IMAGES_DIR.is_dir(), f"Missing rendered guide image dir: {IMAGES_DIR}") + referenced: set[str] = set() + for rel in REQUIRED_PAGES: + text = (GUIDE / rel).read_text() + matches = IMAGE_RE.findall(text) + self.assertGreater(len(matches), 0, f"{rel} must embed at least one images/guide PNG") + for alt, _url, filename in matches: + with self.subTest(page=rel, image=filename): + self.assertGreater( + len(alt.split()), 4, + f"{rel} image {filename} needs descriptive alt text (> 4 words), got: {alt!r}", + ) + png_path = IMAGES_DIR / filename + self.assertTrue(png_path.is_file(), f"Missing PNG {png_path} referenced in {rel}") + width, height = png_dimensions(png_path) + self.assertGreaterEqual(width, 1000, f"{filename} width {width} < 1000 px") + self.assertLessEqual(width, 1400, f"{filename} width {width} > 1400 px") + self.assertGreater(height, 400, f"{filename} height {height} too small") + size = png_path.stat().st_size + self.assertGreater(size, 5_000, f"{filename} looks empty ({size} bytes)") + self.assertLess(size, 650_000, f"{filename} is unoptimised ({size} bytes)") + referenced.add(filename) + + ops_2d = (GUIDE / "operations/operations-2d.md").read_text().lower() + for kind in ("stepover", "entry", "lead"): + with self.subTest(before_after=kind): + self.assertIn(f"{kind}-before.png", ops_2d, f"operations-2d.md needs {kind} before view") + self.assertIn(f"{kind}-after.png", ops_2d, f"operations-2d.md needs {kind} after view") + + on_disk = {p.name for p in IMAGES_DIR.glob("*.png")} + self.assertEqual(on_disk, referenced, "Unused or unreferenced PNGs in site/static/images/guide") + + def test_zola_build_resolves_guide_images_with_prefix(self) -> None: + base_url = base_url, "--output-dir", str(output)], + cwd=SITE, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, + ) + for rel in REQUIRED_PAGES: + slug = rel.removesuffix(".md") + html_path = output / "guide" / slug
